meta.task_name: Live OpenAI integration smoke tests (opt-in) + request validation (fail-fast, UI surfaced)

notes.note: OpenAIIntegration currently defines selected_apis, models, and response_handling, but does not include a required request_validation contract.
TestingStrategy is strong, but does not explicitly require two-tier tests: mocked-by-default + opt-in live smoke tests when OPENAI_API_KEY is set.
Phase-3 prompt rules require tests and mocking, but do not hard-require live smoke tests or request validation before sending requests.

objective.summary: Modify phase-3 CodeSpec schema + phase-3 prompting so every generated CodeSpec: (1) mandates request validation before sending any OpenAI request (model name, required fields, structured-output schema constraints), (2) fails fast with a clear UI-visible error state (no silent failures), (3) requires two tiers of tests: - mocked unit/integration tests that always run by default (CI/local), - opt-in live integration smoke tests that run only when OPENAI_API_KEY is set (or explicit flag), are low-cost, and are safe to skip without failing the default test suite.

step.title: Schema: add OpenAI request validation requirements (required)

field.name: preflight_checks
field.description: Concrete validation checks performed before any OpenAI request is sent. Must include: model name validation; required field presence; structured-output schema constraints validation (e.g., schema is strict-compatible).

field.name: fail_fast_behavior
field.description: Fail-fast behavior when validation fails: what exception/error path is triggered and what the UI shows. Must explicitly state “clear error message surfaced in the UI” and that no request is sent on validation failure.

field.name: ui_error_state_contract
field.description: UI-visible error state contract: where the error appears (banner/toast/panel), and how users recover (e.g., fix key, retry button, reset flow).

field.name: debug_logging_policy
field.description: What metadata is logged for demo debugging (request id, model, timing, status, schema parse outcome), explicitly stating: do not persist sensitive content (no raw prompts/responses or keys).

add_required_field.name: request_validation
add_required_field.description: Required preflight request validation and fail-fast UI error behavior.

notes.note: Keep schema strictness (extra="forbid"). Do not add optional-only validation; this must be required and explicit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: OpenAIIntegration includes required request_validation with explicit preflight checks and UI surfaced fail-fast behavior.
debug_logging_policy explicitly forbids persisting sensitive content.

step.title: Schema: require two-tier tests (mocked default + opt-in live smoke tests)

field.name: always_run_by_default
field.description: Must be true: mocked tests run in CI/local by default.

field.name: coverage_requirements
field.description: What mocked tests must verify. Must include: request payload formation; schema parsing/validation; guardrails short-circuit behavior; tool-call display behavior (if any).

field.name: mocking_strategy
field.description: Deterministic mocking strategy for OpenAI calls (fixtures/snapshots), aligned with existing mocking guidance.

field.name: opt_in
field.description: Must be true: live tests are opt-in only.

field.name: run_condition
field.description: Exact condition under which live tests run. Must mention: OPENAI_API_KEY is set (and optionally an explicit flag like RUN_LIVE_OPENAI_TESTS=1).

field.name: skip_behavior
field.description: Must clearly state: safe to skip without failing default test suite; skipped tests should report as skipped, not failed.

field.name: cost_and_safety_constraints
field.description: Low-cost, minimal calls only using the demo’s default models; avoid high token usage; keep deterministic assertions where possible.

field.name: what_it_verifies
field.description: Must include: request succeeds; response parses successfully; UI/state updates as expected for at least one headline flow.

field.name: commands_or_how_to_run
field.description: Concrete commands/steps to run the live smoke tests locally.

field.name: live_smoke
field.description: Opt-in live integration smoke tests (only with key/flag).

add_required_field.name: openai_test_tiers
add_required_field.description: Required two-tier test plan for OpenAI integration: mocked-by-default + opt-in live smoke tests when OPENAI_API_KEY is present.

notes.note: Keep existing verification_steps list; ensure it includes commands for both tiers and clearly labels live as optional.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TestingStrategy includes required openai_test_tiers with mocked.always_run_by_default=true and live_smoke.opt_in=true.
Live smoke tests explicitly define run_condition, skip behavior (skipped not failing), low-cost constraints, and what is verified.

step.title: Prompts: enforce request validation + two-tier testing in phase-3 output

update_global_hard_rules.add_rule: OpenAI requests must be validated before sending (model, required fields, schema constraints) and must fail fast with a clear UI-visible error message—no silent failures.
CodeSpec must include two-tier OpenAI tests: mocked-by-default plus opt-in live smoke tests that only run when OPENAI_API_KEY is set and are safe to skip without failing the default suite.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: OpenAIIntegration must include request_validation with concrete preflight checks, UI error state contract, and a debug logging policy that avoids persisting sensitive content.

TestingStrategy must include openai_test_tiers: mocked tests validate request formation + parsing + guardrails short-circuit + tool-call display (if any), and live smoke tests (opt-in) prove real connectivity, parse success, and UI/state updates using default models.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include OpenAIIntegration.request_validation (preflight checks + fail-fast UI errors + safe debug logging).
Include TestingStrategy.openai_test_tiers (mocked default + opt-in live smoke tests when OPENAI_API_KEY is set; skipped safely otherwise).

notes.note: Preserve JSON-only output and strict schema adherence.
Do not require live tests in default CI; they must be optional and explicitly gated by env/flag.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase-3 generated CodeSpec reliably includes request_validation and openai_test_tiers (not vague, not optional).

verify.item: After adding nested models to CodeSpec, confirm openai_compatible_schema() still produces strict-compatible schemas (additionalProperties:false, required includes all properties, and $ref-only nodes).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions in strict structured output compatibility.

checks.check: Every generated CodeSpec includes OpenAIIntegration.request_validation with explicit preflight checks and UI-visible fail-fast behavior.
Every generated CodeSpec includes TestingStrategy.openai_test_tiers with mocked-by-default and opt-in live smoke tests gated by OPENAI_API_KEY (and/or explicit flag) and safely skippable.
Live smoke tests are minimal/low-cost, verify success + parsing + UI/state update, and provide concrete run commands.
Prompt rules/checklist force these requirements so downstream coding agents implement them consistently.
